summary: Created from the user's Grow screenshots. MaskManager._morph is a Gaussian blur plus an alpha threshold, which averages instead of taking a maximum - large convex shapes grow correctly, thin limbs thin out and concave gaps fill. Filed under the MPI-440 umbrella and sequenced BEFORE MPI-436, which reuses the same primitive.

User confirmed the scope: grow AND edge, outward AND inward - all four read _morph and all four change. Title now names them. Added the consequence: 'blur once, threshold twice' is not retunable, since one averaging pass cannot be both a max and a min filter - the two ADJUST_ thresholds die with the blur.
